--- ## 为什么需要 Agent Reach？ **Agent Reach 让你的 Agent 真正连上互联网，用上它自己够不着的平台和能力。** Claude Code、Codex、Hermes Agent、OpenClaw 这类 CLI Agent 自带搜索和网页读取，但下面这些它们基本够不着： - **要登录才能用的功能**：在小红书搜笔记、在 X 查账号动态、读职位详情等。 - **视频里的内容**：B站和 YouTube 的字幕，以及 YouTube 视频、小宇宙播客的语音转文字。 - **中文平台**：B站、小红书、V2EX、雪球，通用搜索覆盖很差。 - **干净的结构化数据**：雪球行情、V2EX 帖子和回复、GitHub 仓库和 issue，拿到的是整理好的内容。 Agent Reach 把这些平台背后的工具替你装好、测好，Agent 一条命令就能用： ```bash agent-reach channels # 有哪些渠道、每个渠道能做什么 agent-reach bilibili search "大模型" # agent-reach <渠道> <动作> [参数] agent-reach read https://www.v2ex.com/t/123 # 按链接自动选渠道 ``` ### ✅ 在你用之前，你可能想知道 - **适用于哪些 Agent？** 一切 Agent 都能用。 - **会碰我的浏览器和账号吗？** 要登录的平台用 Agent Reach 自己的专用浏览器，在后台运行、不弹窗。第一次用某个网站时，会把你 Chrome 里这个网站的登录复制一份过去，原浏览器不变，不读密码库。复制过来的通常是主账号，建议换成小号，做法见下面的"安全性"。详见[会话配置](agent_reach/skill/references/sessions.md)。 --- ## 支持的平台 下表是当前版本的情况。 | 渠道 | 等级 | 能做什么 | 需要什么 | |---|---|---|---| | bilibili | 默认 | 搜索、视频信息、热门、字幕 | 无；字幕需要登录（扫码） | | v2ex | 默认 | 热门、节点、帖子和回复、用户 | 无 | | github | 默认 | 搜仓库、读仓库/README、读 issue 和 PR（含评论） | 无 | | youtube | 默认 | 视频信息、搜索、字幕、语音转文字 | 无；转文字需要 Groq 或 OpenAI Key | | web | 默认 | 网页搜索、网页阅读（保底） | 无 | | xiaohongshu | 可选 | 搜笔记、读正文、看评论 | 登录 | | xueqiu | 可选 | 实时行情、搜股票、热帖、热股 | 行情不用登录；热帖、热股要登录 | | boss | 可选 | 搜职位和 JD | 登录 | | xiaoyuzhou | 可选 | 播客转文字 | Groq Key | | linkedin | 可选 | 搜职位、读职位详情 | 公开职位不用登录；站内搜索要登录 | | reddit | 可选 | 搜帖子、读正文、看评论、看版块 | 登录 | | twitter | 实验 | 搜推文、用户资料、用户推文、读推文串 | 登录 | | facebook | 实验 | 搜索、主页资料 | 登录 | | instagram | 实验 | 搜用户、主页资料、用户帖子 | 登录 | - **默认**：装好就能用；不想要也可以去掉，以后更新不会再加回来。 - **可选**：说一句"帮我加上 XX"就开启，需要的软件会自动装好。 - **实验**：能用，但平台反爬更严，可能随时失效。 --- ## 快速上手 把这句话发给你的 Agent： ``` 帮我安装 Agent Reach：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach/main/docs/install.md ``` 无论是安装还是升级，都只需要这一条命令就行了。 剩下的 Agent 自己做完。过程中你可能会被问到： - **允许它执行命令**：如果 Agent 说自己不能运行命令，去它的设置里打开"允许执行命令"。 - **装 uv**：uv 是一个安装命令行程序的小工具，不需要管理员密码。电脑上没有的话 Agent 会先装它，会跟你说一声。 - **要不要加可选渠道**：装完后 Agent 会告诉你哪些已经能用（B站、V2EX、GitHub、YouTube、网页），以及还能加哪些。你选了再加，也可以以后随时说"帮我加上小红书"，一条命令就装好。 关于登录：部分平台会直接复用你电脑上已有的登录。想换成某个特定账号（比如小号），跟 Agent 说一声就行。Agent 从不替你登录，也不会要你的密码。 > ⚠️ PyPI 上叫 `agent-reach` 的包不是本项目，请勿从 PyPI 安装，只用 install.md 里的 GitHub 地址。 --- ## 装好之后怎么管 Agent Reach 装的所有东西（各渠道的工具、登录、设置）都放在你电脑上同一个文件夹里（`~/.agent-reach/`），不散落到别处。所以升级、管理、删除都很省事，一句话就行。 直接用大白话跟 Agent 说： | 你说 | 它会做什么 | |---|---| | "看看 Agent Reach 状态" | 告诉你每个渠道现在能不能用，哪些是上次还好、现在坏了 | | "加上小红书" / "去掉小红书" | 开启并装好它需要的一切 / 关掉它，清掉它的登录和专用工具 | | "小红书登录过期了" / "换个账号" / "退出登录" | 打开登录窗口，由你本人登录 / 清掉这个网站的登录 | | "升级 Agent Reach" | 一次更新程序和各渠道的工具，并告诉你还需要做什么 | | "卸载 Agent Reach" | 先列出要删的东西，你确认后再删 | | "让另一个 AI 也能用" | 给那个 AI 也放一份使用说明 | 出了问题，Agent 会告诉你是哪个平台、什么原因、下一步怎么做。常见问题见 [troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md)。 --- ## 设计理念 ### 🔌 每个平台 = 首选 + 备选的有序工具列表 每个平台的每个动作都有一个按顺序尝试的工具列表。比如读 B站视频先用 bili-cli，失败了自动换 B站公开接口；读网页先用 Jina Reader，再用 Exa。 ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Agent] -->|agent-reach 渠道 动作| B[Agent Reach] B --> C{按顺序尝试} C -->|首选| D[上游工具 1] C -->|失败时备选| E[上游工具 2] D --> F[结果] E --> F F --> A ``` 平台改版、工具失效是常态。换工具只是调整这个列表，Agent 的用法不变。 --- ## 安全性 - **只读**：只搜索和读取，不发帖、不评论、不点赞、不私信。 - **从不替你登录，也不要你的密码。** 部分平台会复用你电脑上已有的登录（只复制这一个网站，原浏览器不变）；确实需要重新登录时才打开专用窗口，由你本人完成。 - **专用浏览器只对你这台电脑开放**，别的电脑连不上它。 - **建议用小号登录。** 复用过来的通常是主账号，而平台可能限制自动访问的账号。想换成小号，跟 Agent 说一声就行。 - **Key 不要发在聊天里**：在你自己的终端里运行 `agent-reach configure groq-key` 填写。 ### 🗑️ 卸载 跟 Agent 说"卸载 Agent Reach"。它会先列出要删的东西，你确认后再删。只删 Agent Reach 自己装的东西，你的其他文件和浏览器都不动。最后它会告诉你怎么删掉程序本身。 --- ## ⭐ 为什么值得 Star 这个项目我自己每天在用，所以我会一直维护它。 - 有新需求或者大家提了想要的渠道，我会陆续加上 - 每个渠道我会尽量保证**能用、好用、免费** - 平台改了反爬或者 API 变了，我会想办法解决 Star 一下，下次需要的时候能找到。⭐ --- ## 致谢 [OpenCLI](https://github.com/jackwener/opencli) · [bili-cli](https://github.com/public-clis/bilibili-cli) · [boss-agent-cli](https://github.com/can4hou6joeng4/boss-agent-cli) · [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) · [Jina Reader](https://github.com/jina-ai/reader) · [Exa](https://exa.ai) ## 联系 - --- ## Why Agent Reach? **Agent Reach connects your agent to the internet for real, giving it the platforms and abilities it can't reach on its own.** CLI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent and OpenClaw come with web search and page fetching, but they mostly can't reach: - **Features that need a login**: listing an X account's posts, searching Reddit, reading LinkedIn job details or XiaoHongShu notes. - **What's inside video**: YouTube and Bilibili subtitles, plus speech-to-text for YouTube videos and Xiaoyuzhou podcasts. - **Chinese platforms**: Bilibili, XiaoHongShu, V2EX and Xueqiu, which general search covers poorly. - **Clean structured data**: Xueqiu quotes, V2EX topics and replies, GitHub repos and issues, already cleaned up. Agent Reach installs and tests the tools behind these platforms for you, so your agent can use them with one command: ```bash agent-reach channels # which channels exist and what each can do agent-reach youtube search "LLM agents" # agent-reach [args] agent-reach read https://www.v2ex.com/t/123 # picks the channel from the link ``` ### ✅ Before you start, you might want to know - **Which agents?** Every agent. - **Does it touch my browser and accounts?** Login channels use Agent Reach's own browser, in the background without windows. The first time a site is used, that site's login is copied over from your Chrome; your browser is not changed and passwords are never read. The copied login is usually your main account, so switching to a secondary one is recommended, see Security below. --- ## Supported Platforms This table reflects the current release. | Channel | Level | What it does | Needs | |---|---|---|---| | github | default | search repos, read a repo/README, read issues and PRs with comments | nothing | | youtube | default | video info, search, subtitles, speech-to-text | nothing; speech-to-text needs a Groq or OpenAI key | | web | default | web search, page reading (fallback) | nothing | | v2ex | default | hot topics, nodes, topics with replies, users | nothing | | bilibili | default | search, video info, trending, subtitles | nothing; subtitles need a login (QR scan) | | reddit | optional | search posts, read text/comments, browse a subreddit | login | | linkedin | optional | search jobs, read job details | public jobs need nothing; in-site search needs a login | | xiaohongshu | optional | search notes, read text, view comments | login | | xueqiu | optional | real-time quotes, stock search, hot posts, hot stocks | quotes need nothing; hot posts and stocks need a login | | boss | optional | job and JD search | login | | xiaoyuzhou | optional | podcast transcription | Groq key | | twitter | experimental | search tweets, profiles, user tweets, threads | login | | facebook | experimental | search, profiles | login | | instagram | experimental | user search, profiles, user posts | login | - **default**: works right after install; you can remove one, and updates won't add it back. - **optional**: say "add XX" to turn it on; whatever it needs is installed for you. - **experimental**: works, but the platform fights automation harder and it can break at any time. --- ## Quick Start Send this to your agent: ``` Install Agent Reach: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach/main/docs/install.md ``` Whether you're installing or upgrading, this one command is all you need. The agent does the rest. Along the way you may be asked to: - **Let it run commands**: if the agent says it can't run commands, turn on command execution in its settings. - **Allow installing uv**: uv is a small tool that installs command-line programs; no admin password needed. The agent installs it first if it's missing and tells you. - **Pick optional channels**: afterwards the agent tells you what works now (web, YouTube, GitHub, V2EX, Bilibili) and what else you can add. Pick now, or later just say "add Xiaohongshu"; one command sets it up. About logins: some platforms reuse the logins already on your computer. Want a specific account instead, such as a secondary one? Just tell your agent. The agent never logs in for you and never asks for your password. > ⚠️ The PyPI package named `agent-reach` is NOT this project. Don't install it from PyPI; use the GitHub URL in install.md. --- ## After Install: Managing It Everything Agent Reach installs (each channel's tools, logins and settings) lives in one folder on your computer (`~/.agent-reach/`) instead of being scattered around. That makes upgrading, managing and removing it easy: one sentence does it. Just tell your agent in plain words: | You say | What it does | |---|---| | "How is Agent Reach doing?" | tells you which channels work right now, and which worked before but broke since | | "Add Xiaohongshu" / "Remove Xiaohongshu" | turns it on and installs what it needs / turns it off and clears its login and private tools | | "My Xiaohongshu login expired" / "Switch accounts" / "Log out" | opens a login window where you sign in yourself / clears that site's login | | "Upgrade Agent Reach" | updates the program and every channel's tools in one go, and tells you anything left to do | | "Uninstall Agent Reach" | lists what would be removed first, and removes it once you confirm | | "Let my other AI use it too" | gives that AI its own copy of the instructions | When something goes wrong, your agent tells you which platform, why, and what to do next. Common problems: [troubleshooting.md](troubleshooting.md). --- ## Design Philosophy ### 🔌 Every platform = an ordered list of tools (primary + fallbacks) Each action on each platform has an ordered list of tools to try. Reading a Bilibili video tries bili-cli first and falls back to Bilibili's public API; reading a web page tries Jina Reader, then Exa. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Agent] -->|agent-reach channel action| B[Agent Reach] B --> C{try in order} C -->|preferred| D[upstream tool 1] C -->|fallback on failure| E[upstream tool 2] D --> F[result] E --> F F --> A ``` Platforms change and tools break all the time. Switching tools only reorders that list; the way your agent uses Agent Reach stays the same. --- ## Security - **Read-only**: it searches and reads; it never posts, comments, likes or sends messages. - **It never logs in for you or asks for your password.** Some platforms reuse a login already on your computer (that one site only, your browser unchanged); a login window opens only when you really need to sign in again, and you do it yourself. - **The dedicated browser is open to this computer only**; other machines can't connect to it. - **Use a secondary account.** The reused login is usually your main account, and platforms may restrict accounts used for automation. To switch, just tell your agent. - **Never paste keys into a chat**: run `agent-reach configure groq-key` in your own terminal to enter one. ### 🗑️ Uninstall Tell your agent "Uninstall Agent Reach". It lists what would be removed first and removes it once you confirm. Only what Agent Reach installed is removed; your other files and browsers stay. At the end it tells you how to remove the program itself. --- ## ⭐ Why star it I use this project every day myself, so I'll keep maintaining it. - When people ask for a new platform, I'll keep adding them - I try to keep every channel **working, easy to use and free** - When a platform changes its anti-bot rules or API, I'll find a way around it Star it so you can find it next time you need it. ⭐ --- ## Credits [OpenCLI](https://github.com/jackwener/opencli) · [bili-cli](https://github.com/public-clis/bilibili-cli) · [boss-agent-cli](https://github.com/can4hou6joeng4/boss-agent-cli) · [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp) · [Jina Reader](https://github.com/jina-ai/reader) · [Exa](https://exa.ai) ## Contact - 📧 **Email:** pnt01@foxmail.com - 🐦 **Twitter/X:** [@Neo_Reidlab](https://x.com/Neo_Reidlab) ## Collaboration / community group For collaboration, or to join the community group, add me on WeChat:
